Rainy Day Games: 下雨天兄妹俩在室内玩的游戏。
It rains all day. Ben and his sister Lily cannot go out to play. They are bored at home.
First, they play cards in the living room. Then Lily has a good idea. They make a big tent with chairs and an old blanket.
They sit in the tent and tell funny stories. Mum gives them hot milk and cookies. The rainy day is not boring at all.
